senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) refreshment, pleasure; esp. ע׳ or גַּן עֵ׳ (abbrev. ג״ע) the garden of Eden; paradise (of the hereafter).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15:7">Gen. R. s. 15</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 2:8">Gen. II, 8</cite>) <he>גן גדול מע׳</he> the garden was larger than Eden, v. <cite ref="C01072"><he>גַּן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:5">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> <he>מכל אילני ג״ע</he>, v. <cite ref="P00153">preced.</cite>
<cite ref="Berakhot 34b:26">Ber. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>גן לחוד וע׳ לחוד</he> the garden and Eden are two distinct things.

<cite ref="Pesachim 54a:8">Pes. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>שבעה דברים … וג״ע וכ׳</he> seven things were created before the world was made: the Law, repentance, paradise, Gehenna, &c. Ber. l. c. (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 64:3">Is. LXIV, 3</cite>) <he>זה ע׳ שלא וכ׳</he> that is Eden which no living creature’s eye has ever seen; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 99a:16">Snh. 99ᵃ</cite>.
